name: Virginia JLARC Data Centers in Virginia Report
update_frequency: One-time legislative evaluation with linked report materials
known_limitations: The report establishes a 2024 statewide and Northern Virginia baseline and policy findings. It does not establish current capacity, approval, construction, service, or operation for a particular data center.
source_owner: Virginia Joint Legislative Audit and Review Commission
automation_notes: Retain as the legislative baseline and follow recommendations into SCC, DEQ, utility, and local-government records.
notes: Phase 55U source. The report identifies Northern Virginia concentration, statewide load implications, and policy options while preserving project-level limits.
